an4.168:1.1: kho āyasmā Mogallāno yen' āyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṅkami . . .
an4.168:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ etad avoca :
an4.168:2.8: Imāsaṃ kho āvuso catassannaṃ paṭipadānaṃ kataman te paṭipadaṃ āgamma anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttan ti?
an4.168:3.5: paṭipadānaṃ yāyaṃ paṭipadā sukhā khippābhiññā, imaṃ me paṭipadaṃ āgamma anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttan ti. 169. 1.
